name: Bada 赤外線IQ・テロメア分裂測定
pipeline: drawing:  絵 -> 方程式 (bond-lines in red-arrow order)
jones:    Jones多項式 V(t) via Kauffman bracket
mirror:   真逆 V(1/t) (opposite-handed / 上がる作用<->下げる作用)
telomere: skein-splitting Hayflick generations + split entropy
thermal:  赤外線カメラ frame + 温度計 -> Boltzmann t_eval
iq:       standardized IQ (mean 100, sd 15), forward + mirror

properties.note: 真逆の性質を内蔵 — every measurement is computed for the diagram and its mirror.
